description: Canonical Accumulate error taxonomy. One catalog, five language bindings. Errors are a property of the Accumulate protocol, not of any SDK. Agents branch on `code`; `retryable` decides whether a retry is productive or a wasted turn.

harvestedFrom: tools/agent-harness/results/2026-07-27 and 2026-07-29 — 80 run records, 68 transcripts of live Kermit agent runs
opendlt-python-v2v3-sdk/unified/src/accumulate_client/runtime/errors.py — ErrorCode enum (SDK-local semantic codes, mirrored from the Go implementation)
tools/agent-harness/negative-cases.mjs — 8 deliberately provoked error responses from a live Kermit V2 node (2026-07-30); source of the verified wire codes -32807, -32802, -32601, -33400
rules: `protocolCodes` lists ONLY wire codes verified from a live response or an SDK's own mapper. An empty array means the code is not yet confirmed on the wire — it is not an assertion that none exists.
`messagePatterns` is how an agent matches a raw error string when no numeric code is available. This is the common case in practice.
`observed: true` means this error was seen in the live harness corpus. `observed: false` entries come from an SDK's declared taxonomy and are not yet corpus-confirmed.

categories.validation: The request is malformed or semantically invalid. Never retryable — fix the input.
categories.not_found: The referenced account, chain, or transaction does not exist on this network.
categories.insufficient_credits: The signing key page lacks credits. Credits pay for execution and are distinct from token balance.
categories.insufficient_balance: The source account lacks the tokens being moved.
categories.auth: The signature, signer, or authority set does not satisfy the principal's requirements.
categories.conflict: The target already exists or the transaction duplicates one already recorded.
categories.pending: Accepted but not yet final — typically awaiting additional multisig signatures.

dart.codeAccess: e.code            // int; e.name for the mnemonic

errors.hint: The account URL does not exist on this network.
causes: typo in the account URL
the account was never created
querying the wrong network (mainnet vs Kermit testnet)
querying immediately after submit, before the transaction reached 'delivered'
a MALFORMED url also surfaces as not-found on V2 rather than as a URL validation error
errors.remediation: Verify the URL and the network. If you just created the account, wait for its creating transaction to reach 'delivered' first — use wait_for_balance / wait_for_credits rather than querying straight away.

errors.hint: The signing key is not on the key page that authorizes this principal.
messagePatterns: key does not belong to signer
causes: signing with the lite identity when the principal is an ADI account
signing with `book/1` when the principal's own book is a different book
the key was rotated out of the page by a prior update_key operation
errors.remediation: Sign with a key that is on the principal's authorizing key page. After create_identity, ADI-owned principals are signed by `<adi>/book/1`. A key page owned by a second book (e.g. `multisig-book/1`) must be signed by that page's OWN book — Accumulate requires every authority to approve.

errors.hint: The signing key page does not hold enough credits to pay for this transaction.
causes: credits were never purchased for this key page
add_credits targeted the lite identity instead of the ADI key page
the credit purchase has not settled yet
errors.remediation: Call add_credits for the SIGNING key page, then wait_for_credits on that same page before retrying. Credits are separate from token balance — an account can hold ACME and still be unable to sign. Note add_credits itself must be signed by an account that already has credits (typically the funded lite identity).

errors.hint: The envelope reached the network without a valid signature over the transaction body.
causes: the transaction body type has no binary marshaler, so only the type number was written
the envelope was hand-rolled instead of built through SmartSigner
a wrong transaction type code produced bytes the validator could not match
errors.remediation: Build and sign through the canonical path — TxBody to construct, SmartSigner to sign and submit. Do not hand-roll envelopes. If you are working ON an SDK and see this for one specific transaction type, its marshaler is missing or its type code is wrong.

errors.hint: The account or identity being created already exists on chain.
causes: a re-run of a script that uses a fixed (non-unique) ADI URL
the previous attempt actually succeeded and the error was misread
errors.remediation: Query the URL first — if it exists and you own it, skip creation and continue. For repeatable scripts, derive a unique URL (e.g. a timestamp suffix) rather than a fixed name.

errors.hint: The principal URL is not a valid target for this transaction type.
causes: sending tokens with the lite IDENTITY as principal instead of the lite TOKEN ACCOUNT
targeting an ADI where a key page is required, or vice versa
errors.remediation: Match the principal to the transaction type. Token transfers use the token account URL (`<lite>/ACME`), credit purchases and key operations use the identity or key page URL.

errors.hint: The source account does not hold enough tokens for this transfer.
causes: the faucet deposit has not settled yet
passing whole ACME where base units are expected, so the amount is 1e8x too large
a custom token's precision is not 1e8 and the amount was scaled wrongly
errors.remediation: Confirm the balance with wait_for_balance before transferring. Build amounts with the Amount helper — 1 ACME = 1e8 base units, and custom tokens carry their OWN precision set at creation.

errors.hint: The transaction was accepted but is not final — it is awaiting additional signatures.
causes: the key page threshold is greater than 1 and only one signature has been collected
polling stopped before the transaction reached 'delivered'
errors.remediation: This is not a failure. Collect the remaining signatures up to the page threshold, then poll status until delivered. Co-sign the EXISTING envelope (SmartSigner.sign_existing / signExisting / SignExistingAsync, or accumulate tx sign --envelope) — signing the same body again creates a DIFFERENT transaction that never reaches the threshold. Collect every signature before submitting: resubmitting one already on chain trips replay protection. Treating pending as success is the common multisig bug; so is treating it as a hard error.

errors.hint: The transaction was submitted and accepted, but did not reach a final state before the wait timed out.
causes: the settle window was shorter than the network's block time
the transaction produced a synthetic message that is still in flight
polling stopped at the first non-final status instead of continuing
errors.remediation: Do NOT resubmit — a resubmit risks a duplicate or an ACC_ALREADY_EXISTS. Keep polling the transaction status until 'delivered', with a longer timeout. Synthetic deposits (faucet, cross-account transfers) routinely need more time than a single block.

errors.hint: The string is not a well-formed Accumulate URL.
causes: missing the `acc://` scheme
an unresolved template placeholder left in the string
on the V2 API a malformed URL is reported as not-found, not as a URL error — match on the code, not the text
errors.remediation: Accumulate URLs are `acc://<authority>[/<path>]`. Lite token accounts end in the token symbol, e.g. `acc://<keyhash>/ACME`.

errors.hint: The JSON-RPC parameters were rejected by the node.
causes: a required field was omitted
a field was sent with the wrong type (string vs number vs hex)
errors.remediation: Check the operation's declared inputs in llms-full.txt. Hashes are 32-byte hex; amounts are base-unit integers, not decimals.

errors.hint: The node does not expose the RPC method that was called.
causes: calling a V3 method against a V2-only endpoint, or vice versa
errors.remediation: Use the SDK's canonical client rather than raw RPC — it targets the correct API version for the endpoint.

errors.hint: The endpoint could not be reached, or the request timed out.
causes: the testnet endpoint is briefly down
a slow faucet or settle step exceeded the client timeout
the response was truncated mid-stream
errors.remediation: Retry with exponential backoff. This is the ONLY class of error where a bare retry is productive — retrying a validation or auth error just burns turns.

errors.hint: The node reported an internal error.
causes: a transient node fault
errors.remediation: Retry once with backoff. If it persists, the request is likely malformed in a way the node did not classify — re-check the transaction body against llms-full.txt.

errors.hint: The node could not determine which partition should handle the request.
causes: the envelope carries no transaction, or a transaction with no principal
the principal URL is empty or unparseable, so there is no routing key
an envelope was hand-assembled and omitted required header fields
errors.remediation: Build the envelope through TxBody + SmartSigner rather than by hand. Every transaction needs a header with a valid `principal` — that URL is the routing key, and without it the node rejects the request before validating anything else.
